Arcanist

You study the impossible until your hands can give it a shape the world must briefly accept.

Rules

Agreed: minimum 0 in Agility, Knowledge; HP contribution +2. No multiclassing.

Starting disciplines: choose two distinct rank-1 disciplines from Flame, Frost, Storm, Scholarship, Calling.

Discipline pricing: Home: Flame, Frost. Adjacent: Storm, Scholarship, Calling. All others Foreign; no Opposed disciplines.

Choose one class-exclusive signature at levels 1, 3 and 7. Extra signatures cost 2/4/8 DP. No discipline requirements.

Level 1 choices

- @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.1e9dae1cf9874f5b.JournalEntryPage.f684ba307c155d29]{Bent Trajectory} - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.d05ae00389833159.JournalEntryPage.21fcaf9e7fd6e445]{Deliberate Spark} - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.845df33e2051ecb8.JournalEntryPage.eee0e32e6040fcf9]{Study the Pattern}

Level 3 choices

- @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.aafee8ae3285cf1c.JournalEntryPage.df650a7d388abbe5]{Cast and Scatter} - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.290faff47db3fa43.JournalEntryPage.9a01bd4b773eb88d]{Leave a Window} - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.b8807f1ba96c6836.JournalEntryPage.2c3538a15d2fdea6]{Arcane Deflection}

Level 7 choices

- @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.fbb32ea4a33ea0c1.JournalEntryPage.e5bb1eb9af6aec0c]{Fold the Distance} - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.d997d0024436e664.JournalEntryPage.281b8bbb56401841]{Choose the Edge} - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.8a23b1c3c9ccfbe1.JournalEntryPage.7a5f9a7a9e7359d3]{Open the Circle}

Signature identity in play

The revised options aim for these moments, with a deliberate advantage over shared cards of their tier. Each is an independent choice, not a progression chain.

- Level 1: Bend spell angles, add a spark's shove, or read active magic. - Level 3: Move after casting, protect one creature from an area, or turn spell pressure aside. - Level 7: Move a companion through space, shape a spell's final displacement, or ward a circle.

Starting coin contribution: +6 coins. See @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.0558be1f6014ee71.JournalEntryPage.880380bcd80cfec6]{starting coins}.
